# Randomness Lab

> An interactive sandbox for understanding luck vs skill, survivorship bias, and decision quality under uncertainty. Inspired by Fooled by Randomness.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, presets, and how the lab works.
- [Lab](/lab): Open a case, inspect luck vs skill, reveal missing data, and update your judgment.
- [About](/about): What Randomness Lab is and the ideas behind it.
